body:
## The short version

The Roadrunner 33 is a three-person, three-season tent with three DAC poles in two diameters, 9.6 mm and 9 mm, two doors and two large vestibules. There's one owner review on Trailspace, from a couple who used it on several multi-day backpacking trips over three years.

## Weather

They report it kept the inside dry through three days of constant rain in Waterton, and that careful pitching let them set it up in the rain without soaking the interior. With the fly off, the mesh made it cool in hot weather. With the fly on, it kept them warm and dry through a snowfall, though snow can load the fly if the guylines aren't staked out.

## Space and layout

It sleeps three with plenty of room, and the owner says there's lots of room for tall people. Two doors and two large vestibules give each person their own entrance and gear space, which helps keep the interior dry.

## Watch the edges

The owner's one warning: the tent's sides can stick out from under the fly, so heads and feet can get wet if you're careless about where you lie.

## Poles and parts

The Roadrunner 33 uses **3 poles**, **9.6 mm and 9 mm** tubing (thicker and thinner poles in the same set), **DAC**.

One retailer listing gives four poles and DAC Press-Fit; the spec listing gives three. Count your set before you order a replacement.

The North Face doesn't publish pole lengths. To match a replacement, lay your pole out straight, measure tip to tip, count the sections, and read the diameter printed near a joint (or use calipers). Then search the Roadrunner 33 in our [pole and parts finder](/poles?model=Roadrunner%2033), compare against measured stock in the [pole size chart](/poles/sizes), or search by measurement in [find a pole by size](/poles/size).

## Bottom line

For a couple or a group of three who want doors and vestibules each, the Roadrunner 33 is a comfortable, weatherworthy tent. Listings disagree on whether it has three or four poles and whether they're DAC Press-Fit or Featherlite, so check yours when replacing one.
